description: Source code for the F1-U split connector handling GTP tunnels, session management, and bearer creation/removal in a 5G network component.

classes.name: f1u_split_gateway_du_bearer
classes.description: Represents a GTP tunnel bearer at the F1-U split gateway, manages bind address retrieval.

classes.name: f1u_split_connector
classes.description: Main class managing F1-U split connection, session creation, bearer management, and demux integration.

methods.name: f1u_split_gateway_du_bearer::get_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address of the UDP session, or an error if unavailable.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new DU bearer, sets up GTP tunnels, and attaches demux dispatch queue.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::remove_du_bearer
methods.description: Removes a DU bearer, disconnects adapters, and removes tunnel from demux.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector::get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the external address for DU, either configured or from default session.
